scope: frozen gate on all33 previously seen primary cached 3D-2D pair updates, desk6 room6 teddy21; reused-scene evaluation, not fresh independent validation
selection: all33 attempts, including failed solves and all rejected/accepted poses; no new fitting/matching, no threshold changes
gate: solver must have applied; >=6 odd source rows; all check projections positive; check median <=4 pixels (V12 sigma2 times Huber delta2), and <=raw initial median with1e-9 tolerance; any failure returns full raw transform exactly
check_data: original odd source-feature rows formerly called validation; now decision inputs, no longer independent evaluation. Cached native source depth and target pixels, no target depth in gate residual. Original target-depth eligibility still present. No new matches or retuning.
truth_use: each scene guard-only finalized before corresponding recorded GT evaluation is opened; no GT in selection

criteria.accounting: all33 decisions accounted, every rejection returns exact raw transform, original source/evidence hashes unchanged
criteria.nontrivial_coverage: at least one accepted update in each of three scenes
criteria.accepted_accuracy: every accepted transform <=3cm/2deg and not materially worse than raw by >5mm/0.5deg, both timestamp protocols
criteria.benefit: at least two scenes have >=1 accepted meaningful improvement against raw baseline using unchanged V12 pair_value
criteria.all_case_medians: selected returned-pose medians not worse than raw or unguarded >5mm/0.5deg in any scene, both timestamp protocols; all attempts included, including fallbacks
criteria.known_extreme_error: teddy201/203 converged extreme error rejected; this is a known regression control, not independent evidence
criteria.overall: all criteria required; failure stops this gate configuration without test-time tuning or BA/online integration

limitations: earlier test-scene failures motivated this development-only gate; no fresh independence claim
median bound can hide up to nearly half bad checks, demonstrated by unit test
raw fallback may already be inaccurate and rejection can discard an actual improvement
decision checks cannot also be reported as independent geometric holdout
no map/BA/trajectory/tracking feedback or test replay; no test-derived threshold calibration
earlier inspected results motivated this gate; these test scenes are reused
successful rollback does not fix an already bad raw initial pose
all-case metrics include fallbacks; accepted-only metrics alone cannot establish useful system accuracy
stop: finish three cached replays and evidence audit, preserve all failures, no retuning or online/BA writeback; publication may include negative results
